newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms Prince Edward Island debt ratings.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms Prince Edward Island debt ratings.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Tuesday it confirmed the debt ratings of Prince Edward Island with stable trends.
The Toronto-based debt rating agency maintained the province's long-term rating at BBB (high) and short-term rating at R-2 (high).

In confirming the ratings, DBRS noted that the province's deficit is a manageable 0.8 percent of gross domestic product and that the province's 41 percent debt-to-GDP ratio is supportive of the current credit rating.
The province's level of debt and taxation structure provide it with a reasonable amount of flexibility in making fiscal adjustments, the agency said.
DBRS cautioned the province is being challenged by federal transfer payment cuts and the expected economic slowdown due to the completion of the Confederation Bridge.
